arguments.sql: SELECT customers.name AS Cliente, SUM(order_lines.quantity * products.unit_price) AS Importe FROM orders JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.id JOIN order_lines ON orders.id = order_lines.order_id JOIN products ON order_lines.product_id = products.id WHERE customers.country = 'IT' AND orders.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY customers.name

arguments.subject: Importe total pedido 2025 - Clientes IT
arguments.body: Adjunto la hoja con el importe total pedido en 2025 por cada cliente de Italia.

with_the_gate.answer: Hoja enviada a Marta Navas con el importe total pedido en 2025 por cada cliente de Italia.
